references.text: Here Jacob instructs his sons to bury him with his ancestors in the cave of the field of Machpelah, where Abraham buried Sarah.
Isaac and Ishmael buried their father Abraham in the cave of Machpelah, where Sarah was also buried.
Jacob was buried in the cave of the field of Machpelah, which Abraham bought as a burial place, and where he buried Sarah.
Connects Jacob's burial wish directly to Abraham's original purchase of the burial site.
Confirms that Abraham's burial completed the family's unity beside Sarah at the same location.
Expands the significance of Abraham's purchase to become a common ancestral tomb for all descendants of the patriarchal family.
